scenes.heading: The Moon changes shape
sentences: Night after night the Moon shows a different face.

scenes.heading: Seven days in
sentences: Seven days after new moon the Moon is 90.2 degrees from the Sun.
We see 50.2 percent of the disc lit, a first quarter.

scenes.heading: Half way round
sentences: At 14.8 days it is opposite the Sun and 100 percent of the disc is lit.
Half the Moon is always lit by the Sun, and we see more or less of that half.

scenes.heading: When the shadow reaches us
sentences: When the Moon stands exactly between us and the Sun its shadow can reach the Earth.
If the Moon is near enough, the point of the shadow, 3.75e8 metres long, reaches the ground and the eclipse is total.

objects.name: Solar eclipse with the Moon near

scenes.heading: Light and shadow
sentences: The phases come from where the Moon is on its orbit.
An eclipse comes from where the shadow falls.
